<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  /**
   * This script syncs a Bricks Accordion Nestable with a Bricks Nestable Slider.
   *
   * Desktop/tablet:
   * - Accordion autoplay is active
   * - Accordion and slider stay synced
   *
   * Mobile:
   * - JavaScript sync/autoplay is disabled
   * - Accordion behaves normally
   */

  /**
   * Minimum screen width where the sync/autoplay should run.
   *
   * 768px and up = active
   * 767px and below = disabled
   */
  const desktopBreakpoint = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)');

  /**
   * Bricks Nestable Slider data-script-id.
   */
  const sliderId = 'mzteyb';

  /**
   * Duration per accordion item in milliseconds.
   *
   * 1000 = 1 second
   */
  const itemDurations = [
    6000, // Accordion item 1
    6000, // Accordion item 2
    6000, // Accordion item 3
    8000  // Accordion item 4
  ];

  /**
   * Select the main accordion wrapper.
   *
   * Add this class to your Accordion Nestable element:
   * js-sync-accordion
   */
  const accordion = document.querySelector('.js-sync-accordion');

  if (!accordion) return;

  /**
   * Select all accordion titles/triggers.
   */
  const accordionTitles = accordion.querySelectorAll('.bm-feature-75-accordion-item__title');

  if (!accordionTitles.length) return;

  /**
   * Select the slider element using the data-script-id.
   *
   * This is used for pause-on-hover.
   */
  const sliderEl = document.querySelector(`[data-script-id="${sliderId}"]`);

  /**
   * Internal state.
   */
  let currentIndex = 0;
  let autoplayTimer = null;
  let isSyncing = false;
  let isPausedByHover = false;
  let isInitialized = false;
  let sliderMoveBound = false;

  /**
   * Gets the initialized Bricks/Splide slider instance.
   */
  function getSliderInstance() {
    return window.bricksData?.splideInstances?.[sliderId];
  }

  /**
   * Gets the duration for the current accordion item.
   *
   * Falls back to 5000ms if no duration is defined.
   */
  function getCurrentDuration(index) {
    return itemDurations[index] || 5000;
  }

  /**
   * Checks whether an accordion title/item is already open.
   */
  function isAccordionItemOpen(title) {
    return (
      title.classList.contains('brx-open') ||
      Boolean(title.closest('.brx-open'))
    );
  }

  /**
   * Opens an accordion item by index.
   *
   * We only click the item if it is not already open.
   * This prevents Bricks from toggling it closed.
   */
  function openAccordionItem(index) {
    const targetTitle = accordionTitles[index];

    if (!targetTitle) return;

    if (isAccordionItemOpen(targetTitle)) return;

    isSyncing = true;

    targetTitle.click();

    setTimeout(function () {
      isSyncing = false;
    }, 150);
  }

  /**
   * Moves the slider to the matching slide.
   */
  function goToSlide(index) {
    const slider = getSliderInstance();

    if (!slider) return;

    slider.go(index);
  }

  /**
   * Opens the matching accordion item and moves the slider
   * to the matching slide.
   */
  function goToIndex(index) {
    const total = accordionTitles.length;

    currentIndex = (index + total) % total;

    openAccordionItem(currentIndex);
    goToSlide(currentIndex);

    startAutoplay();
  }

  /**
   * Moves to the next item.
   */
  function goToNext() {
    goToIndex(currentIndex + 1);
  }

  /**
   * Starts autoplay.
   */
  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();

    if (!isInitialized) return;
    if (isPausedByHover) return;
    if (!desktopBreakpoint.matches) return;

    autoplayTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      goToNext();
    }, getCurrentDuration(currentIndex));
  }

  /**
   * Stops autoplay.
   */
  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoplayTimer) {
      clearTimeout(autoplayTimer);
      autoplayTimer = null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Hover handlers.
   *
   * These are named functions so they can be removed during destroy.
   */
  function onAccordionMouseEnter() {
    isPausedByHover = true;
    stopAutoplay();
  }

  function onAccordionMouseLeave() {
    isPausedByHover = false;
    startAutoplay();
  }

  function onSliderMouseEnter() {
    isPausedByHover = true;
    stopAutoplay();
  }

  function onSliderMouseLeave() {
    isPausedByHover = false;
    startAutoplay();
  }

  /**
   * Manual accordion click handler.
   *
   * When a user clicks an accordion item:
   * - Update current index
   * - Move slider to matching slide
   * - Restart autoplay
   */
  function onAccordionTitleClick(index) {
    return function () {
      if (isSyncing) return;
      if (!isInitialized) return;

      currentIndex = index;

      /**
       * Prevent slider move event from clicking the accordion again.
       */
      isSyncing = true;

      goToSlide(index);
      startAutoplay();

      setTimeout(function () {
        isSyncing = false;
      }, 150);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Store title click handlers so we can remove them later.
   */
  const accordionTitleHandlers = [];

  accordionTitles.forEach(function (title, index) {
    accordionTitleHandlers[index] = onAccordionTitleClick(index);
  });

  /**
   * Slider move handler.
   *
   * When the slider moves, open the matching accordion item.
   */
  function onSliderMove(newIndex) {
    if (isSyncing) return;
    if (!isInitialized) return;

    currentIndex = newIndex;
    openAccordionItem(newIndex);
    startAutoplay();
  }

  /**
   * Adds all event listeners.
   */
  function addEventListeners() {
    accordion.addEventListener('mouseenter', onAccordionMouseEnter);
    accordion.addEventListener('mouseleave', onAccordionMouseLeave);

    if (sliderEl) {
      sliderEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', onSliderMouseEnter);
      sliderEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', onSliderMouseLeave);
    }

    accordionTitles.forEach(function (title, index) {
      title.addEventListener('click', accordionTitleHandlers[index]);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Removes all DOM event listeners.
   */
  function removeEventListeners() {
    accordion.removeEventListener('mouseenter', onAccordionMouseEnter);
    accordion.removeEventListener('mouseleave', onAccordionMouseLeave);

    if (sliderEl) {
      sliderEl.removeEventListener('mouseenter', onSliderMouseEnter);
      sliderEl.removeEventListener('mouseleave', onSliderMouseLeave);
    }

    accordionTitles.forEach(function (title, index) {
      title.removeEventListener('click', accordionTitleHandlers[index]);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Adds Splide slider listener.
   */
  function addSliderListener() {
    const slider = getSliderInstance();

    if (!slider || sliderMoveBound) return false;

    slider.on('move', onSliderMove);
    sliderMoveBound = true;

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Removes Splide slider listener.
   */
  function removeSliderListener() {
    const slider = getSliderInstance();

    if (!slider || !sliderMoveBound) return;

    if (typeof slider.off === 'function') {
      slider.off('move', onSliderMove);
    }

    sliderMoveBound = false;
  }

  /**
   * Initializes the desktop/tablet behavior.
   */
  function initFeatureSync() {
    if (isInitialized) return;

    const slider = getSliderInstance();

    /**
     * If Bricks/Splide is not ready yet, retry shortly.
     */
    if (!slider) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        if (desktopBreakpoint.matches) {
          initFeatureSync();
        }
      }, 100);

      return;
    }

    isInitialized = true;
    isPausedByHover = false;

    addEventListeners();
    addSliderListener();
    startAutoplay();
  }

  /**
   * Destroys/disables the desktop/tablet behavior.
   *
   * Important:
   * This does not destroy the Bricks slider itself.
   * It only removes our custom sync/autoplay behavior.
   */
  function destroyFeatureSync() {
    if (!isInitialized) return;

    stopAutoplay();
    removeEventListeners();
    removeSliderListener();

    isInitialized = false;
    isSyncing = false;
    isPausedByHover = false;
  }

  /**
   * Checks the breakpoint and decides whether to initialize or destroy.
   */
  function handleBreakpointChange() {
    if (desktopBreakpoint.matches) {
      initFeatureSync();
    } else {
      destroyFeatureSync();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Run once on page load.
   */
  handleBreakpointChange();

  /**
   * Run every time the viewport crosses the 768px breakpoint.
   */
  if (typeof desktopBreakpoint.addEventListener === 'function') {
    desktopBreakpoint.addEventListener('change', handleBreakpointChange);
  } else {
    /**
     * Fallback for older browsers.
     */
    desktopBreakpoint.addListener(handleBreakpointChange);
  }
});
</script>
